# Literal flags as foreach() items, a list read by name, and outputs whose names CONF-11 cannot tell.
foreach(_opt -mavx2 -mfma)
  target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_opt})
endforeach()
foreach(_flag IN ITEMS -mavx2 -mfma)
  check_cxx_compiler_flag(${_flag} _tp_has_flag)
  if(_tp_has_flag)
    target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_flag})
  endif()
endforeach()
set(_tp_l -mavx2 -mfma)
list(POP_FRONT _tp_l _tp_first)
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_tp_first})
list(GET _tp_l 0 _tp_got)
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_tp_got})
function(_tp_get_simd)
  cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "" "OUT" "" ${ARGN})
  set(${ARG_OUT} -mavx2 -mfma PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
function(_tp_flags prefix)
  set(${prefix}_FLAGS -mavx2 -mfma PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
function(_tp_argv)
  set(${ARGV0} -mavx2 -mfma PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
function(_tp_fwd)
  cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "" "OUT" "" ${ARGN})
  helios_isa_avx2_flags(${ARG_OUT})
endfunction()
set(ENV{CXXFLAGS} "-mavx2 -mfma")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILE_OBJECT "<CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER> -mavx2 <FLAGS> -o <OBJECT> -c <SOURCE>")
# Round 6: ZIP_LISTS loop variables (one per list, or <v>_<i> for a single one), ISA levels CONF-11
# cannot tell (a variable or generator expression after -march=, /arch: or -m), a quoted list with an
# option, and $ENV{} in a grant.
set(_tp_names avx2 fma)
set(_tp_flags -mavx2 -mfma)
foreach(_tp_n _tp_f IN ZIP_LISTS _tp_names _tp_flags)
  target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_tp_f})
endforeach()
foreach(_tp_p IN ZIP_LISTS _tp_names _tp_flags)
  target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_tp_p_1})
endforeach()
set(_tp_arch haswell)
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE -march=${_tp_arch})
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE /arch:${_tp_arch})
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE -march=$<IF:$<BOOL:${HELIOS_FAST}>,haswell,x86-64>)
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE "-march=x86-64${_tp_level_suffix}")
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE -m${_tp_ext})
foreach(_o "sse4.2;-mavx2")
  target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_o})
endforeach()
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE $ENV{HELIOS_SIMD_FLAGS})
# Round 7: an ISA level from $CACHE{} or $ENV{} (in a grant, through a variable, in CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS), and
# $ENV{} passed to a wrapper, appended to CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS and in the other grants.
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE -march=$CACHE{HELIOS_ARCH})
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE /arch:$CACHE{HELIOS_ARCH})
set(_tp_m -march=$ENV{HELIOS_ARCH})
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_tp_m})
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -march=$CACHE{HELIOS_ARCH}")
function(_tp_wrap t)
  target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE ${ARGN})
endfunction()
_tp_wrap(tp_volk $ENV{HELIOS_SIMD})
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} $ENV{HELIOS_SIMD}")
add_compile_options($ENV{HELIOS_SIMD})
add_definitions($ENV{HELIOS_SIMD})
set_property(TARGET tp_volk APPEND PROPERTY COMPILE_OPTIONS $ENV{HELIOS_SIMD})
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE -m$CACHE{HELIOS_EXT})
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE -mfma4)
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE -mxop)
